name: chuskybrowser
description: Headless browser automation server and OpenClaw plugin for AI agents - anti-detection, element refs, and session isolation
author: Seyyid Annan <seyyid236@gmail.com>

tools.name: chusky_create_tab
tools.description: Open a new browser tab at a URL

tools.name: chusky_snapshot
tools.description: Get accessibility snapshot with element refs

tools.name: chusky_click
tools.description: Click an element by ref or CSS selector

tools.name: chusky_type
tools.description: Type text into an element

tools.name: chusky_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to URL or search macro

tools.name: chusky_scroll
tools.description: Scroll page up/down/left/right

tools.name: chusky_screenshot
tools.description: Capture page screenshot

tools.name: chusky_close_tab
tools.description: Close a browser tab

tools.name: chusky_evaluate
tools.description: Execute JavaScript in a Camoufox tab page context

tools.name: chusky_list_tabs
tools.description: List open tabs for a user

tools.name: chusky_import_cookies
tools.description: Import Netscape cookie file (requires CHUSKY_API_KEY)

tools.name: chusky_handoff_start
tools.description: Hand a tab to the human for a login, a CAPTCHA or a check

tools.name: chusky_handoff_release
tools.description: Return control of a tab to the agent after a handoff.

tools.name: chusky_pay_arm
tools.description: Pay on this tab with the user's own card

tools.name: chusky_pay_status
tools.description: Read a payment attachment

tools.name: chusky_pay_disarm
tools.description: Stop paying on a tab

tools.name: agentcard_enrol
tools.description: Start storing the user's card with AgentCard

tools.name: agentcard_cards
tools.description: List the cards stored for this user (brand, last4, expiry)

tools.name: agentcard_buy
tools.description: Shop for the user at real stores through AgentCard: products, food delivery, table reservations (action reserve) and fli

tools.name: agentcard_merchants
tools.description: Check whether AgentCard can pay at a store before sending the user there

tools.name: agentcard_placeholder
tools.description: The test card to type into a checkout for a stored card (number, security code, expiry that match the card that pays)

tools.name: agentcard_presets_list
tools.description: List this user's spending rules (presets)

tools.name: agentcard_preset_set
tools.description: Create or change one of the user's spending rules

tools.name: agentcard_preset_attach
tools.description: Attach one of the user's spending rules to one of their cards (default: the first card).

scripts.test:mcp: npm ci --prefix mcp && node scripts/test-mcp.mjs && node scripts/test-mcp-package.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:plugins
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.js && node scripts/generate-openapi.js && git add openclaw.plugin.json mcp/package.json mcp/package-lock.json openapi.json
